title: Welcome to Smart Notes Manager
content:
This is your first note. You can create, edit, search, and delete notes using the toolbar above.

Keyboard shortcuts:
- Ctrl+N: New note
- Ctrl+S: Save note
- Ctrl+F: Focus search
- Delete: Remove selected note from the list

title: Python Best Practices
content:
- Use type hints for all function signatures
- Write docstrings for public classes and methods
- Keep functions small and focused on a single responsibility
- Prefer composition over inheritance
- Use dataclasses for simple data containers
- Handle exceptions at the appropriate level
- Write tests before fixing bugs
